name: zvid_palette_remap_find_recipe_index_from_rgb
description: zVid_PaletteRemap_FindRecipeIndexFromRgb builds the black-to-RGB palette-remap recipe used by renderer shade lookups and returns its existing recipe index.
known_limits: VC5SP3 relocation-masked byte verification passes for both zVid_PaletteRemap::FindRecipeIndex and zVid_PaletteRemap_FindRecipeIndexFromRgb in the paired target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and MLIL for 0x46e960 validate the fastcall RGB pointer, stack zVidPaletteRemapRecipe construction, zero color0 endpoint fields, color1 red/green/blue copies from the input, color0Strength zero, color1Strength 1.0f, and tail call through zVid_PaletteRemap::FindRecipeIndex.
The native palette-remap key smoke inserts a matching recipe, calls zVid_PaletteRemap_FindRecipeIndexFromRgb directly, and verifies the returned recipe index.
